description: Locale configuration for Luxembourgish (lb) in moment.js, including date formats, relative time, and phonological rules.

methods.name: processRelativeTime
methods.description: Generates relative time strings based on the key and context.

methods.name: processFutureTime
methods.description: Prepends 'a' or 'an' to future time strings based on phonological rules.

methods.name: processPastTime
methods.description: Prepends 'viru' or 'virun' to past time strings based on phonological rules.

methods.name: eifelerRegelAppliesToNumber
methods.description: Determines if the number triggers the eifeler Regel for phonological context.
